The '''Kiliea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]], a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Southern Core]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Kiliean bolt gun]]s.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Kiliean bolt gun]]|system=Kiliea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kiliea system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-12.<ref name="TEA" />
